purpose: Teach: バリ島/ディスコ/四重奏/チューリップ/ショコラ/ミカン/バルコニー/苺

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがバリ島旅行のお土産くれたわよね
lines.en: Sho, your sister brought back souvenirs from Bali.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia. Gentle warmth on the memory of the gift. Soft, almost absent-minded, like thinking aloud. Pace unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが若い頃ディスコに行ったって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I heard Dad went to discos when he was young.
lines.style: Quiet curiosity, genuinely surprised. Small hesitation before the question, like he's turning something over in his mind. Soft, observant tone — not seeking attention, just processing aloud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと四重奏の演奏会に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, shall we go to a quartet performance together?
lines.style: Tender invitation, opening gently. Slight warmth and hopefulness underneath. Pace patient and unhurried, giving him space to answer. Voice lifts slightly at the end, hopeful but not demanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんのお庭のチューリップ大好き
lines.en: Mei-sister, I really love the tulips in your garden.
lines.style: Bright, genuine enthusiasm without artifice. Opening with direct affection. Pace quick and earnest. Small voice, no performance — just honest feeling pouring out.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがショコラを買ってきて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought home chocolate for us.
lines.style: Gentle, pleased observation. Soft warmth in the voice. Slight pause after his name, like she's smiling. Unhurried pace, savoring the small kindness of the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのミカン大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I really love Grandma's mandarins.
lines.style: Earnest affection, simple and direct. Small voice that carries genuine warmth. No hesitation, just a child stating what he loves. Soft ending, content.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお家のバルコニー、見晴らしいいわね
lines.en: Sho, the view from your sister's balcony is really lovely, isn't it?
lines.style: Reflective admiration, gazing outward. Soft, almost wistful tone. Slow pace. Slight trailing question at the end — inviting quiet agreement rather than demanding response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、苺のケーキ食べたい
lines.en: Mei-sister, I want to eat strawberry cake.
lines.style: Direct, simple desire expressed with quiet certainty. No wheedling — just honest want. Small, clear voice. Slight lift at the end, expectant but gentle.
